description: Scientific Consensus & Replication Failure Auditor — Give a DOI, arXiv id, PMID, URL, title or a free-text claim and get a verdict-first screen of whether the finding has been retracted, contradicted or failed to replicate: ROBUST / CONTESTED / UNREPLICABLE_HYPE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with a 0-100 replicationRiskScore, confidence, a DO_NOT_RELY / VERIFY_BEFORE_RELYING / RELY_WITH_CAVEATS action, a one-line headline and a next step. Checks Crossref,

arxivId.description: arXiv id or arxiv.org URL (2106.09685, arXiv:1706.03762, hep-th/9901001). Resolved through Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex.

doi.description: DOI of the paper to audit (bare, doi: or doi.org URL). Takes precedence over paperTitleOrDoi.

paperTitleOrDoi.description: DOI (10.xxxx/..., bare or doi.org URL), arXiv or PubMed URL, or title of the paper to audit.

pmid.description: PubMed id (digits) or pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov URL. Mapped to the DOI through Europe PMC.

scientificClaim.description: Free-text claim; the originating and closely related works are located by search. Used as context when a paper is also given.

url.description: A doi.org, arxiv.org or pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov URL for the paper.

name: replication-auditor
